name: mcp.riveterhq.com
description:
Riveter turns web research into structured data. Give Claude a list of companies, people, or URLs and ask for new columns: product descriptions, revenue, deep analysis, company headcount, link traces, pricing, tech stack analysis, contact details, a classification, a summary, etc. Riveter runs an AI agent per row that searches, reads pages, and fills in each cell with a sourced answer.

What you can do

- Enrich rows you already have. Paste a list or point at a saved enrichment and get the new columns back. Up to 10,000 rows per run.
- Build a list from a description. "Every lawfirm in Indiana", "every YC W24 company in healthcare", "competitors of Stripe". Riveter generates the rows, and can enrich them in the same run.
- Scrape a page. Clean text or markdown from any URL, including JavaScript-rendered pages.
- Search the web. One-shot search results, or a research agent that answers a question with a structured, schema-shaped response.
- Extract records from a site. Define the fields you want and pull them from listings, directories, or catalogs as JSON.
- Monitor for changes. Run a saved enrichment daily, weekly, or monthly and get alerts or webhooks when values change.

How it works

Long runs are asynchronous. Claude starts the run, checks status, and fetches results when they are ready. Every run has an id you can come back to later, and results stay available in your Riveter account.

Setup

Click Connect and sign in to your Riveter account. Riveter creates an API key for this connection; you can revoke it at any time from Settings → API to disconnect. Runs use credits from your Riveter plan. Free accounts include trial credits.

Read-only tools (status, results, listings) are marked read-only. Tools that start runs or change saved configuration are marked as writes. Stopping a run and pausing a monitor are marked destructive.

Docs: https://docs.riveterhq.com

_published_faq.name: How do I add mcp.riveterhq.com to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor?

acceptedAnswer.text: Add mcp.riveterhq.com to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor by connecting its remote MCP URL in each client's MCP settings. In Claude, add a custom connector. In ChatGPT, add an MCP app. In Cursor, add an MCP server under Settings. The MCP URL is https://mcp.riveterhq.com/mcp. This server requires OAuth, so complete the login prompt after you connect.

_published_faq.name: What tools does the mcp.riveterhq.com MCP server provide?

acceptedAnswer.text: mcp.riveterhq.com lists 26 MCP tools, including build_configured_dataset, build_dataset, build_dataset_for_enrichment, create_enrichment, create_extraction, create_monitor, enrich, extend_dataset, get_account, get_enrichment, get_extraction, and get_monitor.

_published_faq.name: What are the best alternatives to mcp.riveterhq.com?

acceptedAnswer.text: As of October 17, 2026, alternatives to mcp.riveterhq.com in data-analytics on the Manufact MCP catalog include Epicure, Newsflash, Point Topic, Pricing Optimizer AI, and StatCite.
mcp.riveterhq.com requires authentication. Connect it in Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor and complete the OAuth login prompt.
mcp.riveterhq.com is developed by Riveter. It is listed as community on the Claude connector directory.
